schemaNotes.description: The published GET oneOf omits ping although create/list document ping. Positive ping records retain documented list/common fields only. The empty ping settings object appears solely in an explicitly labeled adapter-convention fixture.
The schema describes arrays of target alternatives; its example uses channel-keyed email/sms arrays. Both documented alternatives are separate fixtures, not a fabricated universal provider shape.

GET declares boolean with integer example 30000; create/modify declare integer milliseconds. This corpus uses documented integer semantics. Pingdom latency down alerts differ from Uptime Slow and require review.
Detail has no ID. List IDs and descriptor request/sourceId carry stable identity; native detail objects are unmodified.
Source shouldcontain and shouldnotcontain are mutually exclusive. Positive controls set one or neither; the combination is a separate negative case.
API 3.1 publishes no Page Speed export schema. Operator transcription is separately labeled, not an API response.
Complete public-page and integration-detail APIs are absent from the retrieved schema. Unknown count, not zero; handoff and export still require review.
